notes: spec_copy is the take a break spec 3.2.0 copy, verbatim. rest_care_clock_note_condition is a rule, not copy, and is applied in breaks.py.
draft_copy was written for the build because the spec doesn't supply it.
Placeholders in braces are filled by the API: {trial_end_date}, {break_end_date}, {channels}, {preferred_name}, {last_step}.

spec_copy.presignin_break: Take all the time you need. Nothing has been saved yet, so there's nothing to lose. You can come back whenever you're ready.
spec_copy.setup_break: Of course. Everything you've done so far is saved. Take whatever time you need.
spec_copy.signed_in_nothing_to_pause: Of course. Take whatever time you need. Everything is saved.
spec_copy.quiet_988_line: If you'd like to talk with someone, you can call or text 988, or chat at 988lifeline.org, any time.
spec_copy.draft_pause: Everything you've shared is saved. There's no rush. To protect your privacy, if this isn't picked up again within 28 days, it will be deleted automatically.
spec_copy.draft_resume_question: Would you like to keep going, or look at something else?
spec_copy.rest_choices_question: How long would you like to rest?
spec_copy.rest_normal_clock_note: Your free days keep counting while you rest. They end on {trial_end_date}.
spec_copy.rest_care_clock_note: Your free days will pause while you rest.
spec_copy.break_started: You're on a break until {break_end_date}. I won't send any reminders while you rest.
spec_copy.break_started_open_ended: You're on a break until you come back. I won't send any reminders while you rest.
spec_copy.break_notice_line: I'll send you a short note the day before your break ends, by {channels}.
spec_copy.resting_screen: You're on a break until {break_end_date}. There's nothing you need to do.
spec_copy.resting_screen_open_ended: You're on a break. There's nothing you need to do.
spec_copy.break_ending_notice_body: Your break ends tomorrow. There's nothing you need to do. Cairn will be here when you're ready.
spec_copy.welcome_back: Welcome back, {preferred_name}. Here's where we left off: {last_step}.
spec_copy.trial_resumed_after_care_rest: Your free days were paused while you rested. They now end on {trial_end_date}.
spec_copy.offer_after_time: We've covered a lot. Would this be a good place to rest?
spec_copy.offer_after_task: That's a hard one, and you did it. Would this be a good place to rest, or would you like to see what's next?
spec_copy.rest_subscription_note: Your subscription keeps going as normal while you rest. A break doesn't pause it or change what you pay. This time is just for you.

draft_copy.back_next_action: Pick up where I left off
draft_copy.break_notice_in_app: Your break ends tomorrow. There's nothing you need to do. Cairn will be here when you're ready.
